Thanks for telling me, Nadia. I'll keep the Bluefin and Albany details between us. I won't pass them to Ruth or anyone else, and I won't post them in any channel.

Ruth hasn't been briefed, so she'll need to hear it from you or from Mateo. If you'd like, I can do either of these:
- Draft a short note to Ruth for you to send. It would stay internal to pemberline.com.
- Put a time on both your calendars for a briefing.

Tell me which you want, or if you want neither.
